# GearTiers

`world-system`

Skills capped by the gear (Phase 229): a combat ability needs an equipped weapon of its tier, and a recipe needs a tool and a crafting station of its tier. Empty hands and a missing tool count as novice gear, so novice abilities and recipes need nothing. Skill XP grows with any gear; only use is capped. No weapon reaches these abilities yet: Archery.executePierceShot (expert), Shieldcraft.executeShieldBash (journeyman), Shieldcraft.activateFortify (expert).

> A character that knows more than its gear allows still has to make the gear in this world first

| tiers | json | The gear tiers: the skill tiers, lowest first |

| itemTiers | json | Derived: { <item>: tier } for every piece of equipment |
| abilityGaps | json | Derived: { "<Skill>.<ability>": tier } that no weapon reaches yet (refused until one exists) |
